<!-- pr-reviewer: 0e193bfd7ff7d249a8bd04529329d9098824e075 -->
**Verdict: one fix before merge.** The record matches the maintainer's recorded answers and obeys AGENTS.md, except one kind count and one phase-6 entry.

Docs-only PR. Read and not built. No build was run and no runner was started, per the peer session's ask.

## What looks good

- Every recorded answer of revisions 1 and 2 is captured in the record's "Answered by the maintainer" section, in order: the Outside start shape; Inside and Outside cutting the same passes; trochoidal as load control; Offset rings and Adaptive staying two names; a cut above the load limit re-planned or named; no new material-side field on Pocket and 2D Offset; the folder layout (replaced by the own crate); the exit in the entry stage; the one-go replacement of the planner (not early P1 patches); the side-branch delivery; the kernel as its own crate; the crate name `camcraft-pathkernel`; Bore and Thread in phase 1; the phase order (turning third); the five phase-1 issues #4034-#4038; the side-branch rule and the branch protection; the one heavy motion and app run before the switch-over; the maintainer's approval of the switch-over PR; and "Yes, start".
- The 16 phase-1 kinds match the maintainer's list exactly. Thread is in the Mill2D section and Bore is in the Drilling section (both verified).
- The fit check names what does not fit: tool tilt, a surface guide, the lathe's Z-X plane, the two wire guides, cycles with no path, and the sinker orbit.
- Clean-room: no HSMWorks text, assets or output. "HSM planner" is the codebase's own name for the planner, used in the code the record cites. No process file is touched. The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #4024`. Conventional commit subjects.
- The record does not claim a build: no gate is owed.

## What was checked

- Head is `0e193bfd7`, unchanged since revision 3.
- `gh pr view 4030 --json mergeable`: MERGEABLE, CLEAN. No conflicts.
- No reviews or collaborator markers on this head; no build was run.

## Requested before merge

1. The kind count is wrong. The seed table `KindInfo::ALL` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs:1919`) has 48 rows, and `OpType` has 48 variants. There is no `OpType::RotaryFlow` (the site guide notes operation lists do not offer Rotary Flow yet). The record says "49 kinds", the PR body says "all 49 kinds", and the phase-6 table lists 12 kinds (including "Rotary Flow"). Fix: say 48 kinds. Make phase 6 eleven kinds (drop "Rotary Flow", or say it is a motion kernel, not an operation kind). Fix the "Out (33 kinds)" list to 32, the "Total: 16 + 4 + 12 + 2 + 3 + 12 = 49" line to 16 + 4 + 12 + 2 + 3 + 11 = 48, and the PR body line.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The side-branch rule in AGENTS.md is decided here, but it is not in this PR. It lands as a process change before the branch is made, per the record.
- `side/path-kernel` does not exist yet. That is consistent with the record (the coordinator creates it after this record merges).
- No heavy or light lane is owed, and no example catalog suites are touched: this is a docs-only PR. No test is owed either.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
